about.title: An apartment for living, holidays or investment.
about.imageAlt: Aerial view of the ACIKO Residence building surrounded by greenery
about.statement: A quiet street, greenery outside your window and the spa within easy reach — a home for living slower and better.
about.textA: ACIKO Residence is a boutique building with just 16 apartments on Kneza Miloša Street. Four apartments per floor mean fewer neighbours, more peace and the feeling that you truly know who lives next door.
about.textB: Every apartment is thought through in detail: practical layouts with one or two bedrooms, underfloor heating and air conditioning, large glazed surfaces and terraces facing the greenery. We build the way we would build for ourselves.

living.title: For living
living.text: A quiet street with everything daily life needs close by — without city crowds and rush.

leisure.title: For leisure
leisure.text: Your address in the spa town all year round: springs, parks and promenades are there whenever you need a break.

investment.title: For investment
investment.text: An apartment in Serbia's most visited spa holds its value, and you can rent it to guests when you are not staying there.

build.title: Quality you feel every day.
build.lead: What you cannot see in the pictures but makes an apartment pleasant to live in: walls of Klima blocks, an insulated façade, underfloor heating and aluminium windows.

heating.title: Underfloor heating and air conditioning
heating.text: Warmth spread evenly through the whole apartment in winter, and air conditioning for summer days.

walls.title: Klima block walls
walls.text: Blocks that keep the warmth in during winter and a pleasant temperature in summer.

facade.title: Insulated façade
facade.text: Thermal insulation and natural materials, for lower heat loss and a façade that blends into the greenery of the spa town.

windows.title: Aluminium windows
windows.text: Aluminium windows and doors: sturdy, long-lasting and easy to maintain.
